payload.description_html: Skeletal reconstruction of Dentaneosuchus based on the skull specimens MHNT.PAL.2011.20.1, MHNT PAL 2012.14.23, MHNT.PAL.2012.14.21 and MHNT.PAL.2012.14.1 (Skull elements of a single individual) and the postcranial bones MHNT.PAL.2012.14.2, MHNT.PAL.2012.14.3 & MHNT.PAL.2012.14.24, proportions scaled after Sebecus icaeorhinus, Scalebar =1m, human silhouette by Mette Aumala[1]
